ns2:course.label: Econometrics
ns2:course.description: Develops a general methodological basis for searching for quantitative economic knowledge; integrates and gives operational content to the topics of economic, statistical, and econometric theory. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: ECON 502, or equivalent.
